ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon File Creation By Mysql Daemon Process
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the creation of files with scripting or executable extensions by Mysql daemon.
Which could be an indicator of "User Defined Functions" abuse to download malware.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mysqld\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mysqld\\-nt\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.psm1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$")))
